run_search_searchapi: run search_searchapi to query searchapi.io and return a list of SearchResult objects
build_search_with_google_engine: build a search call using search_searchapi with the google engine to search for a query
build_search_with_bing_engine: build a search call using search_searchapi with the bing engine to search for a query
test_searchapi_filter_results: test search_searchapi with a filter_list to narrow results to specific domains
summarize_search_searchapi: summarize the search_searchapi function that queries searchapi.io and returns sorted SearchResult objects
